scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @onepiece/server" "npm run dev -w @onepiece/client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --kill-timeout 5000 --names SERVER,CLIENT,ADMIN --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @onepiece/server" "npm run dev -w @onepiece/client" "npm run dev -w @onepiece/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @onepiece/shared && npm run build -w @onepiece/server && npm run build -w @onepiece/client
